root_cause: The canonical Netlify applicability authority correctly classified tools/ci/** as governance-only, but Production Source Snapshot and Production Release Readback had independent push.paths-ignore lists that did not contain tools/ci/**. A control-plane merge therefore still allocated both production workflows before the in-job classifier could say deployment_required=false.

evidence.observed_result: both workflows started for a non-Netlify control-plane merge and completed without requiring a Netlify production mutation

prevention.early_trigger: Both Netlify production workflows must ignore tools/ci/** when it is the only affected domain.
prevention.mixed_change_rule: A mixed commit containing any non-ignored runtime path still triggers normal Netlify applicability and fail-closed production proof.
